a_no_rate.why: 去掉 ÷M。H3:若 1/M 只是在制造重尾、污染多头端,去掉它应恢复 valid 段 Q10 的单调性并抬高多头腿;若多头腿反而塌掉,则 1/M 就是信息所在(H2 的放量脉冲读法)

a_width_only.why: 只留几何通道 M,完全不碰价格。H2:若它单独就有可观 rIC 且与 v_base rank 相关 >= 0.3,这条因子本质是成交量形状因子、是 day_std(Amt) 家族的兄弟

a_plain_ret.why: 零假设:把两个成交量谷换成切片的固定两端(day_first/day_last),整套 argmax/argmin 潮汐机械全部拆掉,只剩"10:01 到 14:31 的一段收益的 20 日均值"。H1:若它接近 v_base,这棵树绝大部分复杂度是装饰,因子只是个 20 日反转

a_rank_pre.expr: cross_mean(cs_rank(div(div(sub(day_locate(in_slice(Close, 31, 211), day_argmin(in_slice_to_end(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5))))), day_locate(in_slice(Close, 31, 211), day_argmin(in_slice_from_start(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))))), day_locate(in_slice(Close, 31, 211), day_argmin(in_slice_from_start(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))))), sub(day_argmin(in_slice_to_end(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))), day_argmin(in_slice_from_start(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5))))))), 20)
a_rank_pre.why: 先做截面排序再取 20 日均值,等于保序去尾。H3:若多头端的问题只是 1/M 的重尾,去尾应当保住经济内容同时修好 Q10;注意现在的口径是先 EMA 再排序,所以这是一个真变体不是 no-op(playbook §3)

a_abs.expr: cross_mean(abs_(div(div(sub(day_locate(in_slice(Close, 31, 211), day_argmin(in_slice_to_end(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5))))), day_locate(in_slice(Close, 31, 211), day_argmin(in_slice_from_start(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))))), day_locate(in_slice(Close, 31, 211), day_argmin(in_slice_from_start(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))))), sub(day_argmin(in_slice_to_end(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))), day_argmin(in_slice_from_start(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5))))))), 20)
a_abs.why: 只留幅度不留符号。H4:N ~ sigma*M^(-1/2),若起作用的是强度而不是方向,这一条应当保住甚至更好,并与 ctl_ivol/ctl_range/known_stdamt_* 的相关明显高于 v_base;这是 playbook §6.5 要求的"用同样折叠过的量去比"

a_win30.expr: cross_mean(div(div(sub(day_locate(in_slice(Close, 31, 211), day_argmin(in_slice_to_end(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5))))), day_locate(in_slice(Close, 31, 211), day_argmin(in_slice_from_start(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))))), day_locate(in_slice(Close, 31, 211), day_argmin(in_slice_from_start(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))))), sub(day_argmin(in_slice_to_end(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))), day_argmin(in_slice_from_start(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))))), 30)
a_win30.why: 把 20 日均值换成 30 日(库名 all_tide_mean_30 说的就是 30,而表达式实际写的是 20)。检验 20 是不是调出来的,同时检验"慢变特征"读法:若更长窗口不更差,支持它是特征暴露而不是事件信号

a_win60.expr: cross_mean(div(div(sub(day_locate(in_slice(Close, 31, 211), day_argmin(in_slice_to_end(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5))))), day_locate(in_slice(Close, 31, 211), day_argmin(in_slice_from_start(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))))), day_locate(in_slice(Close, 31, 211), day_argmin(in_slice_from_start(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))))), sub(day_argmin(in_slice_to_end(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))), day_argmin(in_slice_from_start(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5), day_argmax(in_local_mean(in_slice(Volume, 31, 211), 5)))))), 60)
a_win60.why: 同上,窗口拉到 60 日。与 a_win30 一起给出窗口邻域的形状:单峰在 20 说明被调过,平坦或向右上升说明是慢变特征

k_stdamt_mean30.why: 用户指定的第二条已知家族基准,R0 的 digest 里没有打印出来(gates 和 corr_with 里都有它,两处输出都少了它)。把它提成一等变体,拿到它自己的多头腿数字和它与本因子的 rank 相关 —— H6 要用

diagnostics.rank_corr_on: traded signals (sign x panel, smoothed at the fitted half-life); controls raw
